description: This is a Java source file defining the ComponentConfig class, which models the <ofbiz-component> element in Apache OFBiz. It handles loading, parsing, and managing component configuration data from XML files, including dependencies, classpaths, resources, webapp info, and other component-related metadata.

classes.name: ComponentConfig
classes.description: Main class representing the configuration of an OFBiz component, including loading XML configs, managing dependencies, resources, webapps, and various component metadata.

classes.name: ComponentConfigCache
classes.description: Inner class managing cache of component configurations, supporting lookup by name or location, and dependency sorting.

classes.name: EntityResourceInfo
classes.description: Models the <entity-resource> XML element, including resource type and reader name.

classes.name: KeystoreInfo
classes.description: Models the <keystore> XML element, handling keystore properties and loading the key store.

classes.name: ResourceInfo
classes.description: Abstract base class representing component resource info with methods for resource handling.

classes.name: ResourceLoaderInfo
classes.description: Models the <resource-loader> XML element, including name, type, environment variables, and prefix.

classes.name: ServiceResourceInfo
classes.description: Models the <service-resource> XML element, extending ResourceInfo with service-specific attributes.

classes.name: TestSuiteInfo
classes.description: Models the <test-suite> XML element, extending ResourceInfo.

classes.name: WebappInfo
classes.description: Models the <webapp> XML element, including webapp configuration details such as server, context root, init parameters, permissions, and virtual hosts.

methods.name: componentExists
methods.description: Checks if a component with the specified name exists in the cache.

methods.name: getAllClasspathInfos
methods.description: Returns a list of all classpath information from all components.

methods.name: sortDependencies
methods.description: Sorts components based on dependencies using topological sort, throws exception on invalid dependencies or cycles.

methods.name: getComponentConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a component configuration by global name or root location, optionally creating and caching it.

methods.name: getFullLocation
methods.description: Constructs full path to resource within a component.

methods.name: getKeystoreInfo
methods.description: Retrieves the first keystore info matching specified component name and keystore name.

methods.name: getRootLocation
methods.description: Gets the root location of the specified component.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Opens an InputStream to a resource within a component.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Resolves and returns the URL of a resource within a component.

methods.name: getWebAppInfo
methods.description: Finds and returns the WebappInfo for a given server and context root.
